title: Sectionwise localization presheaf on a slice site
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site with commutative structure rings [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U\in\mathcal C$, and $f\in\mathcal O(U)$. A sectionwise localization presheaf at $f$ on $\mathcal C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] consists of a presheaf $L$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] and, for every $V\to U$, an $\mathcal O(V)$-linear isomorphism $e_V:L(V/U)\simeq\mathcal O(V)[1/f|_V]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. For every arrow $g:(W\to U)\to(V\to U)$ and every $a\in\mathcal O(V)$ and $n\geq0$, the coordinates satisfy $e_W(\operatorname{res}_g(e_V^{-1}(a/(f|_V)^n)))=a|_W/(f|_W)^n$. Thus the coordinates identify $L$ with the presheaf of sectionwise localizations, including its restriction maps.
